# Card r1-s-1: Bleed Burst Lancer

## Brainstorm half

### Identity

- Class: Warrior
- Ascendancy: Titan
- Named damage source: Blood Hunt

### Pitch

- Name: Bleed Burst Lancer
- Why pick it: Every hit builds Blood Loss and the lunge spends it, with armour on every slot so the build can stand in the pack.
- How it clears: Lunge into the pack; Herald of Blood pops the bleeding dead.
- Bosses: Build bleed, then lunge to spend it.
- Needs: a spear, Bloodlust, armour on every slot; online at level 9; no respec; moderate
- The catch: The burst needs Blood Loss on the target first.
- Playstyle: melee, few-buttons, tanky

### Chain

- Damage source: Blood Hunt, carried by the weapon in Weapon 1.
- Multipliers: its supports.
- Enablers: none.
- Consumes or requires: nothing.
